question: What is the smallest nested checkpoint-only reader rank that reaches a strong behavior/transport/selectivity Pareto point?

authority.rank4_outcome: The rank-four tensor basis improved every causal metric and passed complement selectivity, but narrowly missed 85% behavior/transport floors.

frozen_design.status: Post-v8 exploratory rank screen only; the selected rank cannot be called confirmed on v8 and must be sealed on a new capability bank.
frozen_design.family: For ranks 2 through 8, retain the frozen rank-two semantic core and append the leading orthogonal singular modes of the identical normalized H3-output-to-L15H5/H1 q/k/q2/k2/v reader map.
frozen_design.arms: Base identity, live writer, full H3, and projected plus exact-orthogonal-complement actuation at every rank 2..8.
frozen_design.selection: Choose the smallest rank with at least 90% full-H3 behavior and downstream transport, and at most 12% absolute behavioral complement, in both panels. Break no ties using v8 magnitudes.
frozen_design.anti_memorization: The family uses no task examples, labels, logits, gradients, or fit updates; v8 is used only to select rank for later sealed confirmation.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_nested_instrument: Authorities, orthonormality, nesting, reconstruction, identity, decomposition, records, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_rank4_replays: Rank-four metrics reproduce the prior result within 1e-6.
predictions.pred_c_small_rank_reaches_pareto_gate: At least one rank no larger than six meets the frozen selection rule.
predictions.pred_d_monotone_static_reader_energy: Static reader-map energy is nondecreasing with rank.

decision: A valid screen reports the smallest passing rank and freezes it for a new-bank test. Failure by rank six shifts the next objective from static checkpoint incidence to activation-conditioned reader Jacobians before regularized DAS.
